These '''Giant skeletons''' are found in the [[Shadow Dungeon]]. They are similar to the [[Giant skeleton (Tarn's Lair)|Giant skeleton]] found in [[Tarn's Lair]], but differ in some ways, such as their examine text and their drops. They have two graphical versions, one with a square shield and sword, and the other with a round shield and axe.
